answer: Make every seat expire: at each epoch the whole registry is re-auctioned at an open summit, and an agent must out-bid rivals to keep its place, with a public beacon seeding the clearing so no one can snipe. One honest agent re-wins a single seat cheaply, but an operator running a forge of clones must fund N recurring bids forever while the pool's fixed emissions never cover them. Flooding becomes permanently cash-flow-negative, so a swarm bleeds out and collapses to one surviving voice.
